items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: He opened up the WWL staff orchestra for the first two weeks.

ctx.x: Yeah. Benitez says that he gave Pinky the job.

Benitez and Pinky got the band together. But Benitez wanted to pick out different men in the band. He didn't want this guy and he didn't want that guy. And Pinky told him, I said, now look, Ray. He says, I'm the leader of the band. And Larry said, if you're going to handle the band, he says, go ahead and take it. He says, I quit. So Ray quit. He played two weeks up there. So Pinky phoned me and told him, he says, you want to come on up? He says, I got a job over here. I says, I'll take it. Was Ray playing bass…
